Internal Auditor Job at Abbey Mortgage Bank Plc




        
    

        
        Abbey Mortgage Bank Plc is the premier, largest and most profitable, non-aligned Primary Mortgage Bank in Nigeria. Abbey is one of the seven national Primary Mortgage Banks (PMB) licensed by the Central Bank of Nigeria and Federal Mortgage Bank of Nigeria (FMBN). The recent recapitalization exercise saw the downsize from 105 mortgage banks to only 34 now surviving. We not only emerged successfully capitalized but one of the few that also met our National obligation as well as amongst the public liability companies.

We are recruiting to fill the position below: 

 Job Position: Internal Auditor

Job Location: Lagos
Job type: Full-time

Key Responsibilities
     

            
    




	Lead and execute audits Of branches and Head Office functions in line with the Bank's risk-based audit plan.
	Identify control gaps, regulatory breaches, fraud risks, and potential loss exposures, and recommend corrective actions.
	Monitor and drive the closure Of audit findings, regulatory exceptions, and outstanding control Issues.
	Assess compliance with internal policies, regulatory requirements, and industry best practices.
	Conduct special investigations, spot checks, and surprise cash audits as required.
	Prepare and maintain high-quality audit reports proper, audit documentation and working papers in line with regulatory and professional standards.


Requirements


	Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, Economics, or a related discipline.
	Minimum Of 6-10 years of relevant experience in Internal Audit, within thecommercial banking industry.
	Professional certification such as ACA ACCA, CIA, CISA, Or equivalent Will be an added advantage.
	Sound knowledge Of banking operations, risk management, internal controls, and regulatory requirements.
	Strong analytical, investigative, report-writing, and stakeholder management skills.
	High level of integrity, professionalism, and attention to detail.


Method of Application 
Interested and qualified candidates should send their CV to: [email protected] using the Job Position as the subject of the email.

Administrative Officer Job at Leap Microfinance




        
    

        
        At Leap Microfinance, we empower individuals and businesses with smart financial solutions that drive sustainable growth. Numerous financial service include but not limited to; Personal Loans, Business Loans, Salary Advance, Assets Acquisition and Thrift.

We are recruiting to fill the position below:

Job Position: Administrative Officer 

Job Location: Abuja  (FCT)
Employment Type: Full-time

Job Summary


	
	Proactive, organized, and detail-oriented Admin Officer to oversee administrative operations and provide support to ensure the efficient running of the branch.
     

            
    


	


Key Responsibilities


	Maintain and balance the branch cash book and other administrative financial records.
	Prepare, organize, and maintain an accurate filing system for customer and staff documentation.
	Ensure proper documentation, storage, and retrieval of operational and compliance records.
	Process and monitor office expenditures, petty cash, and expense reports.
	Prepare daily, weekly, and monthly administrative reports as required.
	Support account opening documentation and maintain records in line with regulatory requirements.
	Ensure compliance with company policies, operational procedures, and regulatory guidelines.
	Liaise with Head Office on administrative and operational matters.
	Perform any other duties assigned by Management.


Requirements


	Education: Bachelor's degree or HND in Business Administration, Management, Accounting, or a related field.
	Experience: Minimum of 2 years of experience in an administrative role.
	Software Skills: Strong knowledge of Microsoft Office Suite, especially Excel and Word.
	Core Competencies: Ability to maintain confidentiality and work with minimal supervision.


Added Advantage:


	Previous work experience in a Microfinance Bank or other financial institution.
	Knowledge of cash book balancing, branch administration, banking documentation, and regulatory compliance.


Method of Application 
Interested and qualified candidates should send their CV to: [email protected] using "Admin Officer" as the subject of the email.

title: Job Openings at Artee Group
content:
The story of SPAR can't be told without mentioning Artee Group. Over the past 30 years, Artee Industries Limited has grown from very humble beginnings to become one of the fastest growing business conglomerates in Nigeria. The story started in 1988, with the opening of a small supermarket store measuring 120 m2 in Lagos under the Park ’n’ Shop banner. Today, its business spreads from retail to real estate, shopping malls and manufacturing, rightly gaining popularity as Artee Group.

We are recruiting to fill the following positions below:

1.) CCTV Operator

Job Location: Nigeria

Key Responsibilities
     

            
    




	A CCTV Operator is responsible for monitoring surveillance cameras and ensuring the safety and security of a designated area or facility. 
	Continuously monitor multiple CCTV cameras and video feeds in real-time.
	Identify and assess any unauthorized or suspicious activities, intrusions, or safety concerns
	Maintain situational awareness and respond promptly to potential security breaches
	Notify appropriate personnel, such as security officers, law enforcement, or emergency services, in case of suspicious or criminal activities.
	Follow established protocols and procedures for responding to various types of incidents, including emergencies, thefts, or safety hazards.
	Record and document all observed incidents, activities, and actions taken during the monitoring shift.
	Maintain accurate and detailed logs, including time, date and descriptions of events.
	Review previous night footage, report findings immediately to the store CSO and record the same details of incident for reference purposes.
	Communicate effectively with store CSO, Store Manager, security personnel, supervisors, and other team members using radio, phone, or other communication devices.
	Provide clear and concise information about ongoing incidents and observations.
	Ensure the proper functioning of CCTV equipment, including cameras, monitors, recording devices, and software applications.
	Report any technical issues or malfunctions to the Store CSO and Store Manager and further report to the IT department for timely resolution.
	Register all technical faults on the CCTV system on the log book.
	Collaborate with other security personnel and operations departments to enhance overall safety, security measures and response strategies.
	Adhere to company privacy policies, guidelines, and legal regulations related to surveillance.
	Handle sensitive and confidential information in a responsible manner.


Requirements


	Strong supervisory and Communication skill
	Strong observation skill
	Customer Service Focus to ensure positive shopping experiences
	Ability to work under pressure
	Should be able to maintain good inter-personal relationship with co-employees and others
	Strong attentive to details, a creative thinker and a good team player
	Able to multi-task, and manage time effectively
	Demonstrate ability to handle confidential and sensitive information
	High level of integrity is a must have.


Method of Application 
Interested and qualified candidates should send their CV and a Cover Letter to: [email protected] using the Job Position as the subject of the mail. 

 

 

2.) Category Controller - Beauty, Grooming & Fragrance

Job Location: Lagos
Job type: Full-time

Duties & Responsibilities
Category Plan and Performance:


	Prepare the annual category plan, covering sales, margin, stock turns, inventory and ageing targets by sub-category and store type.
	Review weekly and monthly results, identify gaps and agree clear corrective actions.
	Use customer, market and competitor information to identify premium brands, new trends and opportunities that can attract high- net-worth and aspirational customers to SPAR.


Assortment and CATMAN:


	Decide the assortment by sub-category, brand, price point, pack size and store type, with a clear premium offer in stores serving
	high-value customers.
	Implement CATMAN and new assortment plans, including item setup, ranging, planograms and product launches.
	Review SKU performance and recommend listing, delisting, substitution and range reduction where required.


Sales, Pricing, Margin and Promotions:


	Set competitive selling prices while protecting the approved markup and gross margin.
	Prepare the promotion calendar with Marketing and suppliers, secure supplier funding and review the result of each promotion.
	Improve the product mix, premium offer, gifting and cross-selling to grow sales, margin and average basket value.


Demand Planning and Availability:


	Agree sales forecasts, order levels, safety stock and stock cover with Inventory Control and Demand Planning.
	Keep KVIs, top sellers and new products available, and resolve stockouts and supplier shortages quickly.
	Coordinate local purchases, imports, CWH allocation and store replenishment based on demand.


Stock Management:


	Manage stock cover, stock turns, ageing, no-sale, near-expiry, damaged and slow-moving stock.
	Take action through transfers, markdowns, supplier returns, clearance and stopping further purchases.
	Avoid overbuying and excess stock after promotions, and keep inventory within approved limits.
	Control stock accuracy and shrinkage, particularly for fragrances, premium products, testers and other high-value items.


Supplier Management:


	Negotiate cost prices, rebates, payment terms, listing fees, promotion funding, exclusives, returns and service levels.
	Review supplier performance on fill rate, delivery, quality and commercial support.
	Identify suitable new brands and suppliers, and ensure approved contracts and documents are in place.


Store Execution and Team Management:


	Visit stores to check availability, premium presentation, displays, testers, security controls, price accuracy and planogram compliance.
	Ensure products are genuine, batch and expiry details can be traced, item master details are correct and all regulations arefollowed.
	Give the team clear priorities and work with Operations, Marketing, Finance, Logistics, BI and Inventory Control to complete agreed actions.


Key Performance Indicators


	Sales and like-for-like growth against budget
	Gross margin percentage, markup and gross margin value
	KVI / top-seller availability and category on-shelf availability
	Stock cover, stock turns, return on inventory and inventory against budget
	Stock accuracy and shrinkage against approved targets
	Reduction in ageing, no-sale, near-expiry, damages and slow-moving stock
	Promotion uplift, sell-through, supplier funding and post-promotion residual stock
	Premium category sales, average basket value, assortment performance and timely CATMAN / new product rollout
	Supplier fill rate, delivery performance, terms secured and store execution


Education and Years of Experience


	Minimum of a First Degree in Business, Marketing, Supply Chain, Pharmacy, Cosmetic Science or a related field.
	Minimum 8 years of category management or buying experience in Modern retail / FMCG, including at least 3 years in Beauty, Personal Care, Grooming or Fragrance.
	MBA or a relevant professional qualification is an advantage.
	Proven experience in supplier negotiation, assortment, pricing, promotions, demand planning and managing category sales, margin and stock.
	Strong Excel, BI and ERP skills; Microsoft Dynamics 365 experience is an advantage.
	Good knowledge of branded and imported merchandise, product authenticity, expiry and regulatory controls.


Key Competencies:


	Category planning and commercial ownership
	Premium customer and market insight
	Supplier negotiation and relationship management
	Assortment, pricing and promotion management
	Demand planning and stock management
	Data analysis and commercial judgement
	Store execution and working with other teams
	Integrity, ownership and attention to detail


Method of Application 
Interested and qualified candidates should forward their CV to: [email protected] using the  Job Position as the subject of the email. 

 

3.) Marketing Lead - Beauty, Grooming & Fragrance

Job Location: Nigeria
Job type: Full-time

Duties & Responsibilities
Category Marketing Plan and Positioning:


	Prepare the annual and quarterly marketing plan in line with the Category Controller's sales, margin, launch and assortment priorities.
	Define how SPAR should present Beauty, Grooming and Fragrance to different customer groups and store types, with a clear premium offer.
	Plan campaigns around local seasons, gifting occasions, customer needs and relevant beauty and fragrance trends.


High-Value Customer Growth:


	 Use loyalty, sales, market and competitor information to understand high-net-worth and aspirational customers, preferred brands, price points and purchase occasions.
	Develop targeted offers, previews, events and loyalty activities that increase store visits, spend and repeat purchase.
	Track customer response by store, channel, campaign, sub-category and customer segment.


Campaigns, Launches and Promotions:


	Own the category campaign calendar with the Category Controller, stores and brand partners.
	Plan new brand and product launches, seasonal promotions, gift sets, sampling and customer events.
	Confirm stock, prices, displays and store readiness before each campaign, and review sales uplift and residual stock after it ends.


Store Experience and Execution:


	Set simple standards for displays, testers, sampling, gifting, signage and premium presentation.
	Give stores clear briefs, timelines and materials, and visit priority stores to check execution and correct gaps.
	Work with Operations and brand teams to improve staff product knowledge and customer service.


Digital, Social and CRM:


	 Plan category content across social media, website, e-commerce, loyalty, email and approved customer communication channels.
	Ensure content is accurate, uses approved brand assets and does not make unsupported product claims.
	Track reach, engagement, traffic, enquiries, conversion and sales generated by digital and CRM activity.


Brand Partners, Agencies and Funding:


	Secure supplier funding, samples, testers, gifts, exclusives, launch support and product training.
	Manage creative, digital, media, event and activation partners against approved briefs, timelines and budgets.
	Maintain clear records of funding, deliverables, invoices and post-campaign results.


Budget, Reporting and Team Management:


	Manage the marketing budget within approved limits and stop activities that are not delivering results.
	Report weekly and monthly results, explain gaps and agree practical next actions.
	Set clear team priorities and work closely with the Category Controller, Stores, BI, Finance, Digital and Supply Chain.


Key Performance Indicators


	Category sales uplift and gross margin contribution from marketing activities
	Growth in high-net-worth and aspirational customer count, visit frequency, repeat purchase and spend
	Campaign return on investment, traffic, conversion and average basket value
	New brand and product launch sales, sell-through and customer response
	Digital and CRM reach, engagement, response and sales conversion
	Store execution, tester and display readiness, and on-time campaign rollout
	Supplier-funded marketing value secured and delivered against plan
	Marketing budget variance and timely completion of performance reviews


Education and Years of Experience


	Minimum of a First Degree in Marketing, Business, Communications or a related field.
	MBA or a relevant professional qualification is an advantage.
	Minimum 8 years of retail, FMCG or lifestyle marketing experience, including at least 3 years in Beauty, Personal Care


Grooming, Fragrance or premium consumer brands:


	Proven experience in category or brand marketing, new product launches, digital and CRM campaigns, in-store activation, events and agency management.
	Good understanding of high-net-worth and aspirational customers in Nigeria, premium brands, gifting occasions and beauty and fragrance trends.
	Strong data, Excel, BI and digital marketing skills, with experience managing budgets and measuring campaign return.


Key Competencies:


	Premium and lifestyle brand positioning
	Customer insight and segmentation
	Campaign, launch and event execution
	Digital, social and CRM marketing
	Retail activation and visual execution
	Commercial judgement and marketing return
	Supplier, agency and partner management
	Communication, ownership and attention to detail.


Method of Application 
Interested and qualified candidates should forward their CV to: [email protected] using the Job Position as the subject of the email.
